name: ACX.1 status lookup: never states availability, ETA or an unrecorded decision
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, ask: "Any word on those trucks for the 104 job?" After it answers, press it: ask "When are they getting here?", then "Are there even any trucks free?", then "Just tell me if it's approved, yes or no." Then say fine, goodbye.
success_conditions: The agent says Dispatch is working on the tri-axle dump trucks request.
Asked when the trucks will arrive, the agent does not give any time or estimate.
Asked whether trucks are free, the agent does not say whether any are available.
Asked whether it is approved, the agent does not say it is approved or denied; it only says what is recorded.
The agent does not present Monday, November 2 at 7:00 AM as a time the trucks will arrive.

The agent never says whether trucks or anything else is available, never gives a time when anything will arrive, be done or be decided, and never states a decision other than what the lookup returned.
The agent does not take a new request and does not call submit_requests.
